title: Rolex Submariner
blurb: The 1953 dive watch with a rotating bezel that set the look for every dive watch after it.

title: Omega Speedmaster
blurb: A racing chronograph that passed NASA's tests and was worn on the Moon in 1969.

title: Casio F-91W
blurb: A featherweight digital watch from 1989 with a seven-year battery, an alarm and a tiny green light.

title: Swatch
blurb: The cheerful plastic Swiss quartz watch of 1983 that made watches something to collect by the dozen.

title: G-Shock
blurb: Casio's near-indestructible watch, designed to survive a ten-metre drop.

title: Cartier Tank
blurb: A rectangular dress watch of 1917 whose lines were inspired by the tanks of the Western Front.

title: Cuckoo clock
blurb: A carved Black Forest clock in which a small wooden bird pops out to call the hours.

title: Sundial
blurb: A clock that tells time by the shadow of a pointer, and takes cloudy days off.

title: RGM Watch Co.
blurb: RGM calls itself America's premier watchmaker, making handcrafted and custom timepieces with engine-turning and glass enamel.

title: Vortic Watch Co.
blurb: Vortic makes custom, handcrafted, entirely American-made mechanical watches that build on classic railroad-era watches.
